The card machine may not work, carry enough cash and ask beforehand
Nov 2018 • Friends
I dined there yesterday. The food is good, the ambience is nice, the servers are helpful. Unfortunately, I got a surprise. At the end of the meal I was told the card machine isn't working and I must pay in cash. It's a bad surprise to get specially when you've spent nearly a million dong on food. I don't usually carry cash much but I happened to have that much money in this instance.

This sort of information should be given at the beginning of the meal not at the end. I really wonder how embarrassing would it be for me if I had ordered some dessert. :)

If you're gonna go there, do yourself a favor, carry lots of cash. This is an expensive fine dining restaurant. Ask them before your meal... Is your card machine working today?
